$doc: Exceptions for scripts/audit-vocabulary.mjs. `devicePatterns` are regexes (case-insensitive) matching 'frame' used for the PHYSICAL DEVICE - the one meaning CLAUDE.md keeps. `exact` are whole UI strings that are fine as written. `viewPatterns` are regexes for 'view' NOT meaning the pre-model facet (point of view, web view...) - 'view' is report-only either way. Add a device pattern only when the sentence is about the device on the wall; never to quiet a slot/facet/layout usage - since the SM-6 rename those fail the gate and are renamed, not excused.
